svg.title: Histogram: request latency by version as an overlaid ECDF with the tooltip open, and pod memory by region stacked on a log axis with other (2) and the coverage meter popover
svg.desc: Mockup 42 (T21 part 2a, #154). Dark theme, 1440 by 900. The board release health with two histogram panels. Panel 1, Request latency by version: auto bins of 50 ms from 0 s to 800 ms over samples pooled over the last hour, grouped by version and overlaid: each version is a 1.5 px step outline in its colour and dash (v2.30 solid, v2.31 dashed) over a 12 percent fill, with its exact ECDF curve in the same dash on the right axis from 0 to 100 percent with ticks at 25 percent. The pointer is on the 250 to 300 ms bin of v2.31 and the tooltip reads the bin count and share for each version, the exact share at or below 300 ms for each, and the footer Values pooled over Last 1 hour. Coverage 100 percent. Panel 2, Pod memory by region: an instant result, one value per series, on a log value axis from 53.6 MiB to 9.31 GiB, stacked by region with the seven largest regions in natural name order, each with its own pattern, and other (2) drawn last in the grid pattern and the category-other colour; bins have a 1 px gap, a 72 percent fill and a full-strength top edge. The coverage meter reads 2 at or below 0 not shown (log) as a focused button, and its popover lists ca-central-1 (in other (2)): 1 at or below 0 and eu-west-1: 1 at or below 0. Callouts: 1 exact ECDF, 2 dash and pattern channels, 3 no time axis, 4 log axis and other (2), 5 meter exclusions.
